home.mascotGreeting: Nice to see you! Shall we start slowly?

review.topic: Last time, which topic did you choose for your memory?
review.topicExplanation: That's right. You chose a memory about {{topic}}.
review.emotion: Do you remember how you said you felt then?
review.emotionExplanation: Yes, you said you felt {{emotion}} then.
review.people: In the memory you saved last time, who was with you?
review.place: Do you remember where that memory happened?

story.people: Who was with you in the story you shared last time?
story.place: Which place appeared in the story you shared last time?
story.object: Which object was a cue in the story you shared last time?
story.emotion: Which feeling was closest to the story you shared last time?
story.time: Which time cue appeared in the story you shared last time?
story.summary: Which story is closest to the memory you shared last time?

story.label: My Story
story.helper: This is not a test. It leaves concrete memory cues you can revisit later.
story.speakBody: Press speak and talk comfortably for about 20 seconds.
story.unsupported: Speech recognition is limited in this browser. You can leave the story in the box below.
story.placeholder: Example: Last spring, I went to the hospital with my daughter and ate soup nearby. It rained, and I felt grateful because she brought an umbrella.
story.privacy: Personal stories are private by default and are not shared with family unless you choose to share them.

garden.subtitle: A garden where your own memories grow.

family.title: Family
family.subtitle: Share memories with one trusted guardian.
family.inviteBody: Invite a family member so they can encourage learning and view shared memory cards.
family.privacyBody: Memory cards are private by default. Only items chosen by the user are shared with family.
family.summaryEmpty: There is no activity to share yet. Keep practicing gently.
family.demoModeNote: Only user-approved activity records and memory cues are summarized here.

conversation.noPrivateDetailsNote: Memories that were not shared are not shown to family or counselors.

report.routineTrendUp: Participation in the last 7 days is higher than the previous 7 days. Continue with gentle encouragement.
report.routineTrendDown: Participation in the last 7 days is lower than the previous 7 days. Suggest an easy restart without pressure.
report.routineTrendFlat: Participation has not changed much in the last 7 days. Keep a short routine at a familiar time.

strengths.routines: {{count}} activities have been completed so far.
strengths.consistency: About {{completionRate}}% of recorded activities were completed, showing routine participation.
strengths.reviewCadence: There are no memory cards due right now, so conversation can stay light.
strengths.routineMomentum: Recent participation is increasing, so brief encouragement may help.
strengths.gentleStart: There is limited data so far. Support a comfortable start rather than evaluation.

nextTopics.shareableSeed: Start by saving one short memory the user is comfortable sharing.
nextTopics.topic: Prepare a light question from {{count}} saved memory item(s) about {{topic}}.
nextTopics.reviewDue: {{count}} memory card(s) are due today and can be used as conversation starters.
nextTopics.routineConsistency: If participation decreased, suggest restarting with the easiest activity rather than asking why.
nextTopics.routineMomentum: Recent participation is increasing. Encourage the same short routine at a familiar time.
nextTopics.prepareConversation: Use shared memories to ask about one specific scene before the conversation.

family.counselorSubtitle: Activity records to help prepare for conversations.
family.counselorDisclaimer: This data is from a local demo and is not a medical test. It does not indicate disease risk or progression.

cues.fallbackEasiest: Ask which activity felt the easiest during today's practice.
cues.fallbackTomorrow: Ask what kind of practice they would like to try again tomorrow.
cues.askSummary: Ask a little more about the shared story '{{summary}}'.
cues.askEmotion: Ask what made them feel '{{emotion}}' at that time.
cues.askPeople: Ask if they have other fond memories with '{{person}}'.
cues.askPlace: Ask what they would want to do first if they went back to '{{place}}'.
